back: tz_localize attaches a zone to naive times (same numbers). tz_convert changes the clock of aware times (same moment).
Store and join in UTC. Convert to local time only for features like hour of day, or for display.

front: How many hours can a local day have because of DST?
back: 23 on spring-forward day, 25 on fall-back day, 24 on other days.
Text like 03/04/2024 can mean 3 April or 4 March. A format removes the doubt.

front: What does Timestamp minus Timestamp give?
back: A Timedelta, a length of time. It has .days and .total_seconds().
